Assignment Title: Online Payment System Using Interface Multiple Inheritance

Assignment Question:
Develop an Online Payment System for an e-commerce application. The system should support two independent capabilities: payment processing and transaction notification. Create an interface Payment containing the data members MAX_AMOUNT = 100000 and the abstract method makePayment(double amount), and another interface Notification containing the data member MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH = 100 and the abstract method sendNotification(String message). Create a class OnlinePayment that implements both Payment and Notification, thereby demonstrating multiple inheritance through interfaces. The class should contain the data members transactionId, amount, and message, along with methods makePayment(), sendNotification(), and validation methods validateAmount() and validateMessage(). The payment amount must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 100000, while the notification message must not be null or empty and must contain at most 100 characters. If all inputs are valid, the system should process the payment and display the transaction details; otherwise, it should display Invalid Input.

             |                                 |
             +----------+------------+

·       message must not be null or empty.
·       message length must not exceed 100 characters.
·       All input validation must be performed before processing the payment.
